mcp_tools.name: tech_stack_decision_memo
mcp_tools.title: Tech stack decision memo
mcp_tools.description: Submits a tech-stack decision memo record (context and constraints, declared candidate rows and boring-technology declarations, evaluation criteria rows and evidence, total-cost and operability declarations, decision and rationale, reversibility and exit declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic TECH_STACK_DECISION_SOUND / TECH_STACK_DECISION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed criterion-reference, weighted-score recomputation and decision-candidate consistency checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared memo record only; it recommends no stack, picks no stack and ranks no candidate.

inputSchema.description: The tech stack decision memo manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
